'''Nebula Communications''' was a communications company during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was based inside the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] security expert [[Zee K'lin]] worked in a consulting position for Nebula Communications, and the company maintained an [[Nebula Communications security offices|office suite]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:CZ" />
